title: Spellcast Slave Induction (Story Induction)
description: Welcome back. Or maybe its your first time? That's okay. We're just going to have a bit of fun... To see the world, the worlds within these books. To disappear into the hidden adventures I describe. To absorb each word which is read aloud. Becoming so enchanted by my tales that the world outside seems to just fade away. Wouldn't you like that? To live the story, and after have such marvelous dreams. Just picture the spiralling bookshelves... As your fingers trail along the spines. My influence, a spell guiding upon you. Just relax for me... As you find the book of my whims.
author: Mistress Shibby
